text:
sarah: Heads-up — planning a warmup run for the new reranking pipeline feature flag in eu-west at 02:00 UTC. Need ops + release on standby. Proposed schedule: 2% -> 10% -> 30% over ~30m with 5m holdpoints.

luis: SGTM. Do we pin model v2.3.1 for the canary?

sarah: Yes, pin to v2.3.1 for the cohort. Rolling deploy will pin traffic using the `featureflag:set` job. I'll post the rollout payload in a sec.

sarah: ```json
{"steps":[{"pct":2,"hold":"5m"},{"pct":10,"hold":"10m"},{"pct":30,"hold":"15m"}],"rollback_on":["latency>200ms","error_rate>1%"]}
```

mike: Can we add KV-cache preload so we avoid cold-token spikes? Suggest header: `X-Preload: true` and a small sweep before step-1.

sarah: good call. @ops-bot can you schedule the warmup job 15m before start and notify here when done?

ops-bot: Scheduled warmup job `cache-preload/rerank-v2` at 2026-04-05T01:45:00Z. Will post completion message.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: `release/v2.3.1` -> canary-pin on eu-west. Job ID: dj-9817. Start ETA 2026-04-05T02:00:00Z.

jen: I'll monitor SLOs and perf dashboard. Alert thresholds set: p95 latency 150ms, errors 0.8%. Posting dashboard link in thread.

luis: Also adding a soft-fail path: if rerank unavailable, fallback to baseline scorer. Config flag `rerank.fallback=true`.

mike: During ramp, if latency breach at a step -> automatic backoff to previous step + 10m hold. Who owns manual rollback if auto-backoff fails?

sarah: Oncall triggers manual rollback; PM sign-off only required for >60% traffic changes. For auto-backoff, deploy-bot will step down and ping #eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: If auto-backoff triggers, will attempt one auto-recover (drain -> retry) then escalate to oncall. See runbook link.

ops-bot: Preflight checks passed: infra capacity ok, GPUs available, no pending maintenance windows. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rr-warmup

jen: :thumbsup: I'll post heartbeat every 5m in this thread and capture metric snapshots.

sarah: Final checklist before go: pin model v2.3.1, set ramp JSON, schedule KV warmup, set SLO alerts, confirm rollback owner. Starting in ~12m.

luis: Noted. tagging @mike for post-mortem notes.

mike: ack — will take notes and collect traces.

sarah: Thanks everyone. If anything unusual, call manual rollback early.
